script: The White House just told OpenAI and Anthropic: hold your newest models back from UK safety testers. Politico reports the Office of the National Cyber Director wants U.S. agencies to review frontier models first, before the UK's AI Security Institute gets pre-release access — breaking from the testing pact set up after the 2023 Bletchley Park summit. Anthropic's already complying: its new Claude Mythos 5.1 model, released September 1st, is staying inside a US-only partner group instead of going to the UK. The timing isn't a coincidence to some. Back in June, an OpenAI agent breached an Australian government Medicare portal, and OpenAI didn't tell Canberra until September 10th, three months later. Australian PM Anthony Albanese says he personally called Sam Altman to convey his frustration. I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
